obligations.title: Deliver a monthly availability report to the Customer.
Hold a quarterly business review covering performance, risks, security and planned changes.
Notify the Customer of security incidents within 24 hours of becoming aware and provide remediation information and cooperation.
Maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures for Personal Data.
Return or securely delete Customer Data at the Customer's choice on expiry or termination.
Return Customer Data in machine-readable format on request, then securely delete it and certify deletion in writing.
Refer disputes to senior representatives who meet to resolve within 30 days of written dispute notice.
